title: S77 — Verify: S53 hard-corpus reproducibility (seed 53, manifest hash must match)
desc: GOAL: regenerate the S53 hard corpus with the frozen recipe at seed 53 and match the recorded manifest sha256 (44b79be7ea90…, full value in reports/s53-hard-corpus/); publish a one-command regeneration receipt. WHY: the corpus feeds training lanes — if it cannot be regenerated bit-identically, training receipts become unreproducible. EVIDENCE: reports/s53-corpus-regen/<date>.md (command, timing, hash match) + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: regeneration + receipt only; on hash mismatch: document the diff and STOP, escalate on groupchatcode. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
